D: A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a shot at the world heavyweight title.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky runs up the museum steps.
S: Rib eye frozen 30 minutes, shaved thin, seared on a hot plate with onions, provolone melted over, piled into mini rolls.
the run through the Italian Market
Salami, prosciutto, provolone, marinated artichoke, olives and roasted capsicum on a board with crusty bread.
Philly soft pretzels with beer cheese

Chewy figure-eight pretzels dipped in hot bicarb water, baked deep brown with rock salt, served with yellow mustard and a sharp cheddar beer cheese dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g yeast, 1 tbsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 320ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll 8 ropes and twist into figure eights. Dip each for 30 seconds in 2L simmering water with 80g bicarb soda, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, 150ml lager and 200g grated cheddar until smooth.
M: the turkey Paulie throws out the back door

Brined turkey breast roasted golden and sliced thick, with sage and onion stuffing, cranberry sauce and a rich pan gravy. Keep it on the table. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2L water with 100g salt and 50g sugar. Pat dry, rub with 40g butter and roast at 170C to 70C inside, about 80 minutes, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 200g torn bread with a sauteed onion, 40g butter, sage and an egg and bake 30 minutes. Stir 1 tbsp flour into the tray juices, add 400ml chicken stock and simmer for gravy. Serve with cranberry sauce.
the sides of beef Rocky punches in Paulie's meat locker
Sirloin dry-brined overnight, seasoned with cracked pepper, seared in a smoking cast iron pan, flipped every minute, basted with butter, garlic and thyme, pulled at 54C and rested. Roast potatoes.
W: Cuff and Link, the turtles from Adrian's pet shop
Little clusters of toasted pecans topped with a spoon of soft caramel and a cap of melted dark chocolate, set on baking paper so each one looks like a turtle.
K: the five raw eggs at 4am, but drinkable
A ripe banana, cold milk, a big spoon of peanut butter, oats and a little honey blended thick. Rocky's raw egg version not recommended.

s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear on a hot plate with a sliced onion. Lay over 6 slices provolone to melt, then pile into 12 mini rolls.

s.note: the run through the Italian Market
s.how: Arrange 100g salami, 100g prosciutto and 150g provolone on a board. Add a jar of drained artichoke hearts, olives and roasted capsicum. Serve with a crusty loaf torn into pieces.

m.note: the sides of beef Rocky punches in Paulie's meat locker
m.how: Dry-brine 4 sirloins overnight and season with cracked pepper. Sear in a smoking cast iron pan, flipping every minute. Baste with 40g butter, garlic and thyme and pull at 54C. Rest and serve with 1kg roast potatoes.

w.note: Cuff and Link, the turtles from Adrian's pet shop
w.how: Toast 150g pecans and arrange in clusters of 4 on baking paper. Melt 200g caramels with 2 tbsp cream and spoon onto each cluster. Top with 100g melted dark chocolate and set.

d.note: the five raw eggs at 4am, but drinkable
d.how: Blend 2 ripe bananas, 800ml cold milk, 2 tbsp peanut butter, 40g oats and a spoon of honey until thick. Pour into four glasses. Skip the raw eggs, Rocky.
